notes: The MIT BioMicroCenter pricing pages are reachable, and the main page and FY2025, FY2025b and FY2023 snapshots were fetched. The history view (action=history) returned 403, so I used the per-year snapshot pages. Main page (last edited 15 Apr 2025) and FY2025 (pricing update 7/1/2024, edited 12 Jun 2024): NovaSeq 6000 S-series prices are identical, so there was no 6000 cut in 2024-25. S4 300nt is $5,400 per lane (core lab), up from $5,000 in the FY2023 snapshot (pricing update 7/1/2022): +8%. S1 and S2 are also up about 8%. AVITI prices are unchanged across FY2025, FY2025b and the main page. Jan 2025 (FY2025b) added NovaSeq X prices for the 300nt cycle: 10B at $1,850 and 25B at $3,650 (core lab). The 25B is about $1.22 per M read pairs, assuming '3b reads' means 3B read pairs. The page's X price of $3,650 is the only X price on any snapshot; the Apr 2025 main page replaced X prices with 'pricing in ilabs'. The cost of the 6000's S4 lane ($5,400 for about 2B reads, so about $2.70 per M reads) compares with the X 25B at about $1.22 per M reads, which is about 55% lower per read. The 25B is also 3B reads at $3,650 against the S4's 2B at $5,400. Limits: the data stops at Apr 2025, there is no 2026 snapshot, and read counts come from the page's labels.
how_to_mine: Try the FY2024 and FY2023b pages (BioMicroCenter:PricingFY2023b, and the FY2024 equivalent if one exists). Try oldid revisions via index.php?title=BioMicroCenter:Pricing&oldid=N, or the Wayback Machine for 2025-2026 snapshots of the main page and ilabs pricing. Check the FY2021 and FY2022 pages for the 6000 price path since 2019. The MIT iLab (ilab.mit.edu) price list is login-gated, so skip it.

items.label: 1A
items.claim: MIT's core raised NovaSeq 6000 prices about 8% from FY2023 to FY2025 while it listed X flow cells at much lower $/read; the 6000 premium persists.
items.detail: S4 300nt lane was $5,000 (core lab) in the 7/1/2022 update and $5,400 in the 7/1/2024 update, unchanged through Apr 2025; S2 300nt rose from $12,500 to $13,500 (+8%). In Jan 2025 the same core listed X 25B 300nt at $3,650 for 3B reads against S4 at $5,400 for about 2B, about 55% lower per read. This is a core's posted price, not a transaction price from Illumina.
items.why_new: MIT BioMicro Center is not among the core rate cards already used; it gives a dated 6000 vs X price pair.

items.label: 2A
items.claim: The MIT core held AVITI prices flat across 2024-25 and priced the AVITI 75PE lane at $1,000 for about 400M reads, about $2.50 per M reads.
items.detail: AVITI 150PE lane (~400M reads) is $1,375 (about $3.44 per M reads) on all three snapshots (Jun 2024, Jan 2025, Apr 2025). The X 25B 300nt is $3,650 for 3B reads (about $1.22 per M reads). The core thus kept a stable low-end AVITI price while the X gave a lower $/read at the high end.
items.why_new: Adds MIT AVITI vs X per-read price comparison; not in the known core list.
